summary: Enhance your understanding of credit risk regulation with our global standards and compliance training. Equip yourself for success in the financial sector.
lede: Credit risk regulation training explains how standards shape lending decisions, capital, provisioning and oversight. For credit risk, compliance, audit, finance and portfolio professionals, it develops practical skills in applying Basel approaches to measure exposures, interpreting IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, and preparing regulatory reports and for supervisory reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly deal with credit portfolios, credit policy, regulatory reporting, and risk oversight:
audience: Credit risk managers and analysts in banks
Chief Risk Officers and risk leadership teams
Portfolio managers and credit committee members
Credit policy and product development teams
modules: Foundations of Credit Risk and Global Regulation
Basel Frameworks: Evolution and Core Concepts
Credit Risk Measurement under Basel Standards
Credit Risk Governance, Policies, and Risk Appetite
Stress Testing, ICAAP, and Scenario Analysis for Credit Risk
Supervisory Reviews, Compliance Culture, and Enforcement
Future Trends in Credit Risk Regulation and Digital Lending
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of banking operations and credit risk management.
